audits.dominantPattern: Small personifications of objects and geography (river, store, bench, wagon, slips) plus permission tags

audits.p5p6SecondSweep: Re-read every sentence for inanimate or abstract subjects carrying verbs of agency, cognition, desire, motion or combustion, and for body-part subjects. The second sweep added A-I03 (edge came into voice), A-I06 (fingers did not want), A-I07 (river talking to itself), A-I13 (crystal woke), A-I14 (bench drinking), A-I16 (road losing itself) and A-I04 (loads carried a word, actor omitted). It kept literal physics (damp came up, river slapped, candle flame lay over, sun moved), standard road-extent verbs (road ran, went off, went by), the crystal's light leaning (subject matter) and involuntary body responses (ears went red, shoulders came down, teeth chattered, eyes came open at the light). See the scratchpad.

summary.verdictReason: FAIL: 51 KILLs (8 MODERATE, 43 MILD). MODERATE comes from cluster-rule escalation of two repeated negation shapes: Cyndia defined by refusal (6x) and the 'without being told' initiative shape. Intent-smear clusters at L269-289 (severe) and repeated 'the depot' as a person. Tic 5 gaze beats are over cap (10 vs 4), filter_watched is over cap (8 vs 3) and narration colons are over cap (17 vs 13). Every KILL has a low-difficulty drop-in fix: 8 are deletions and most of the rest are cuts of a single clause. Not verdict-driving: structural texture deficit (score 73.5, below_target, 29 flagged zones); structural rhythm concerns: sentence_length_cv, long_sentence_pct, opener_entropy, one_sentence_paragraph_pct, mattr.
